title: 計程車 / Uber
description: 搭乘計程車或叫車服務的用語

sentences.en: Could you please take me to the international convention center, which is located on the corner of Fifth Avenue and Park Street, as quickly as possible?
sentences.zh: 能否請你盡快載我到國際會議中心，它位於第五大道和公園街的轉角？

sentences.en: The estimated fare shown on the app, which factors in current traffic conditions and surge pricing, seems considerably higher than what I normally pay.
sentences.zh: 應用程式上顯示的預估車資——已考量目前路況和動態加價——似乎比我平常付的貴很多。

sentences.en: I would prefer it if you could take the highway instead of the city roads, even though it might be slightly longer, because there is less traffic at this hour.
sentences.zh: 我比較希望你走高速公路而不是市區道路，雖然可能稍遠一點，但這個時段車流量較少。

sentences.en: Since my flight departs in less than three hours and the airport is quite far from here, I was wondering if you could avoid any routes with heavy congestion.
sentences.zh: 因為我的班機不到三小時就起飛，而且機場離這裡很遠，不知道你能否避開塞車嚴重的路線？

sentences.en: The driver, who was very knowledgeable about the city's shortcuts, managed to get us to the restaurant in half the time I had originally expected.
sentences.zh: 那位對城市捷徑非常熟悉的司機，用我原本預期一半的時間就把我們載到了餐廳。

sentences.en: I noticed that the meter started at a base fare that seemed higher than usual, so could you please explain how the pricing works during late-night hours?
sentences.zh: 我注意到計費表的起跳價似乎比平常高，能否請你解釋一下深夜時段的計費方式？

sentences.en: Before we get going, I just want to confirm that you accept credit card payments because I don't have enough cash on me for a trip this long.
sentences.zh: 出發前我想確認一下你是否接受信用卡付款，因為這麼長的車程我身上沒有足夠的現金。

sentences.en: The ride-sharing option, which pairs you with other passengers heading in the same direction, can reduce your fare by up to forty percent during peak hours.
sentences.zh: 共乘選項會幫你配對同方向的其他乘客，在尖峰時段最多可降低百分之四十的車資。

sentences.en: Would you mind pulling over near that convenience store on the right so that I can quickly run in and grab something before we continue to my destination?
sentences.zh: 你介意靠右邊那間便利商店停一下嗎？我想快速進去買個東西再繼續前往目的地。

sentences.en: According to the app notification I just received, my driver is currently three minutes away and will be arriving in a silver sedan with the license plate ending in seven-two-five.
sentences.zh: 根據我剛收到的應用程式通知，我的司機目前三分鐘後到，開一台車牌尾號七二五的銀色轎車。

sentences.en: I am traveling with two large suitcases and a carry-on bag, so I was hoping you could confirm that your vehicle has enough trunk space to accommodate them.
sentences.zh: 我帶了兩個大行李箱和一個隨身包，所以希望你能確認車子的後車廂有足夠空間放得下。

sentences.en: The surge pricing that occurs during Friday evenings, when everyone is trying to get home or go out, makes taking a taxi almost twice as expensive as usual.
sentences.zh: 週五晚間大家都在趕著回家或出門時出現的動態加價，讓搭計程車幾乎是平時的兩倍貴。

sentences.en: Could you drop me off at the main entrance of the hospital rather than the side gate, because my elderly mother is waiting for me there with her wheelchair?
sentences.zh: 能否請你在醫院正門讓我下車而不是側門？因為我年邁的母親正坐著輪椅在那裡等我。

sentences.en: Having accidentally left my phone in the back seat of the taxi I took earlier today, I immediately contacted the dispatch center hoping they could help me retrieve it.
sentences.zh: 今天稍早不小心把手機忘在計程車後座，我立刻聯繫調度中心希望他們能幫我找回來。

sentences.en: The driver suggested an alternative route that goes through the residential area, which he claimed would save us at least fifteen minutes despite being slightly longer in distance.
sentences.zh: 司機建議了一條穿過住宅區的替代路線，他聲稱雖然距離稍遠，但能省下至少十五分鐘。

sentences.en: I would like to schedule a pickup for tomorrow morning at seven thirty, as I need to arrive at the conference venue no later than eight fifteen.
sentences.zh: 我想預約明天早上七點半的接送，因為我需要不遲於八點十五分抵達會議場地。

sentences.en: The taxi rank outside the train station, which usually has a long queue of waiting cars, was completely empty when I arrived due to the unexpected rainstorm.
sentences.zh: 火車站外通常排滿候客車輛的計程車招呼站，因為突如其來的暴風雨在我到達時完全空了。

sentences.en: If the traffic on the main road continues to be this congested, it might be faster to take a detour through the back streets that run parallel to the highway.
sentences.zh: 如果主幹道繼續這麼塞，走與高速公路平行的後街繞道可能會比較快。

sentences.en: I appreciate you waiting while I finish this meeting, which should take no more than twenty minutes, and I will pay the waiting fee without any problem.
sentences.zh: 感謝你等我開完這場不超過二十分鐘的會議，等候費我會照付沒問題。

sentences.en: The safety features built into the app, including real-time trip tracking and an emergency button, give me peace of mind whenever I travel alone at night.
sentences.zh: 應用程式內建的安全功能，包括即時行程追蹤和緊急按鈕，讓我每次深夜獨自搭車都很安心。

sentences.en: Excuse me, but I think you may have taken a wrong turn back there because the GPS on my phone shows we should have gone straight instead of turning left.
sentences.zh: 不好意思，我覺得你剛才可能轉錯了，因為我手機的導航顯示我們應該直走而不是左轉。

sentences.en: The luxury car option, which costs about three times more than the standard service, includes complimentary water bottles and phone chargers for passengers.
sentences.zh: 豪華車選項大約是標準服務的三倍價格，為乘客提供免費瓶裝水和手機充電器。

sentences.en: Would it be possible for you to turn down the air conditioning a little bit, as it is quite cold in the back seat and I forgot to bring my jacket today?
sentences.zh: 可以請你把空調調小一點嗎？後座蠻冷的，而且我今天忘了帶外套。

sentences.en: After comparing the fares quoted by three different ride-hailing apps, I decided to go with the one that offered a discount code for first-time users.
sentences.zh: 比較了三個不同叫車應用程式的報價後，我選了那個提供新用戶折扣碼的。

sentences.en: The receipt that the driver handed me at the end of the trip, which I need for my expense report, shows the total fare including the airport surcharge.
sentences.zh: 司機在行程結束時給我的收據——我需要用來報帳——上面顯示了含機場附加費的總車資。

sentences.en: I have been waiting at the pickup point for over ten minutes, but the driver seems unable to locate me despite my sending him my exact GPS coordinates.
sentences.zh: 我已經在接送點等了超過十分鐘，但司機似乎找不到我，儘管我已經把精確的GPS座標傳給他了。

sentences.en: Since this is my first time visiting the city and I am not familiar with the local geography, I am relying entirely on you to choose the most efficient route.
sentences.zh: 因為這是我第一次來這個城市，對當地地理不熟悉，所以完全依賴你選擇最有效率的路線。

sentences.en: The driver politely informed me that he could not take the tunnel route because large vehicles are restricted during certain hours due to ventilation system upgrades.
sentences.zh: 司機禮貌地告訴我他不能走隧道路線，因為某些時段大型車輛因通風系統升級而被限制通行。

sentences.en: If you could provide me with a printed receipt that includes the date, pickup location, and drop-off address, that would be very helpful for my reimbursement claim.
sentences.zh: 如果你能提供一張包含日期、上車地點和下車地址的紙本收據，對我的報銷申請會非常有幫助。

sentences.en: The cancel fee that was charged to my account even though the driver took more than fifteen minutes to arrive seems unfair, so I plan to dispute it through the app.
sentences.zh: 儘管司機花了超過十五分鐘才到，我的帳戶還是被收了取消費，這似乎不公平，所以我打算透過應用程式申訴。
